summary: Regression after code-review fixes. Backend: full suite `pytest tests/` 30 passed/1 skipped (spoof test skipped on localhost by design); against public URL test_katalog_pendaftaran.py 12/12 passed incl. duplicate phone 409 and spoofed X-Forwarded-For -> 6th request 429 (anti-spoof fix verified). New tests/test_lapak_foto.py 3/3 on localhost and public URL: upload JPG -> foto_url /api/publik/foto/{id}?v=N, public GET 200 image/jpeg (JPEG magic bytes), delete -> 404; no-login upload 401; text/plain 415. Frontend: katalog tab hidden file input upload -> thumbnail src ?v=1 + btn-hapus-foto shown, non-image toast 'Foto harus JPG, PNG, atau WEBP'; public card lapak-foto uses the uploaded photo (no 'Foto ilustrasi' label); hapus -> table 'contoh' and public card falls back to pexels illustration + lapak-foto-contoh. ScanQr: camera start/stop no crash, manual LPK-JMB-001 and JSON payload both resolve to I Wayan Sudira, unknown ID shows error toast, penagih select + Sudah Bayar -> LUNAS toast. Public registration: dialog -> daftar-sukses -> wa.me/6281234567890 link; same phone same stall -> 409 toast 'Nomor ini sudah mendaftar...'. All requested items PASS.

minor.issue: Only clears foto_path in Mongo; old object stays in object storage (orphaned blobs). Acceptable if storage has no delete API, otherwise consider cleanup/soft-delete flag.
Image type validated only from client-declared Content-Type; no magic-byte check (a non-image declared image/jpeg is stored and served publicly as image/jpeg). Low risk since admin-only.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: delete/replace photo should clean up storage objects; optionally verify image magic bytes on upload.
critical_code_review_comments: storage._call fix is correct: resp always defined, single retry with forced new key on 404 for non-GET
ratelimit.client_ip fallback to request.client.host for short XFF chains verified effective via public URL
Pre-existing: QR 'Sudah Bayar' allows multiple LUNAS payments for the same periode (LPK-JMB-001 now has several 'Sewa Tahunan 2026 Lunas' rows) - consider idempotency per tenant+periode
seed_data_creation: TEST_ units/photos removed (no TEST_ units, 0 units with foto_path, tenants=14), TEST_ pendaftaran deleted so rate limit is clear. One extra LUNAS payment recorded for LPK-JMB-001 by QR regression (left).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q ; BACKEND_URL=$REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL python -m pytest tests/test_katalog_pendaftaran.py tests/test_lapak_foto.py -q -n0. Multipart upload with auth_client: strip Content-Type header (see _csrf_headers in test_lapak_foto.py). Rate limit keys on real IP; clean db.pendaftaran TEST_ records before UI registration tests.
